name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck kitchen orders
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving even when the signal drops out. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can manage to cook, then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU WON'T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches what the kitchen can do.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE WINDOW
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what is next and what is done, and alerts you when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over the local network, and order tickets will print automatically.

KEEP SERVING EVEN WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS OUT
Switch on outage protection ("offline protection" in the app) and, if the connection drops, ordering in advance pauses so nobody places an order you won't see. Orders taken on the device stay saved and sync as soon as you are online again.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Leave the screen on during service, get notifications when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and places once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is meant for food truck operators and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
